WITH route AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('LINESTRING (-111.249209 44.684521, -111.249271 44.684729, -111.249369 44.684961, -111.249421 44.685043, -111.249491 44.685115, -111.249598 44.685197, -111.250226 44.685521, -111.250512 44.685724, -111.2507 44.685872, -111.250798 44.685978, -111.250856 44.68605, -111.250885 44.68611, -111.250892 44.686183, -111.250878 44.686278, -111.250868 44.68635, -111.250852 44.686435, -111.250848 44.686546, -111.250866 44.686636)', 4326)::geometry AS geom
),
dem_clip AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(ST_Clip(d.rast, ST_Envelope(r.geom))) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us d, route r
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, r.geom)
),
segments AS (
  SELECT (ST_DumpSegments(r.geom)).geom AS seg
  FROM route r
),
endpoints AS (
  SELECT
    ST_StartPoint(seg) AS p1,
    ST_EndPoint(seg)   AS p2,
    ST_Length(seg::geography) AS seg_len_m
  FROM segments
),
elev AS (
  SELECT
    e.seg_len_m,
    ST_Value(dc.rast, 1, e.p1) AS z1,
    ST_Value(dc.rast, 1, e.p2) AS z2
  FROM endpoints e, dem_clip dc
),
slopes AS (
  SELECT
    seg_len_m,
    CASE WHEN seg_len_m > 0 THEN ABS(z2 - z1) / seg_len_m ELSE NULL END AS grade
  FROM elev
  WHERE z1 IS NOT NULL AND z2 IS NOT NULL
),
avg_grade AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(grade * seg_len_m) / NULLIF(SUM(seg_len_m), 0) AS g
  FROM slopes
  WHERE grade IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT DEGREES(ATAN(g)) AS slope_degrees
FROM avg_grade;

  FROM roads
  WHERE road_name ILIKE 'Beaver Street'
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Clip(
      r.rast,
      b.geometry,
      TRUE
    ) AS clipped_rast
  FROM
    public.dem_us r,
    beaver_street_geom b
  WHERE
    ST_Intersects(r.rast::geometry, b.geometry)
),
slope_raster AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Slope(clipped_rast, 1, '32BF') AS slope_rast
  FROM
    clipped_dem
)
SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(value), 2) AS average_slope_degrees
FROM
  slope_raster s,
  LATERAL ST_DumpAsPolygons(s.slope_rast) AS (geom geometry, value double precision);
